customHUD_menu_main_desc: Most settings need a level restart to apply
customHUD_menu_enable_teammatepanels_des: *Only disables the core hud, such as player panels
customHUD_menu_hudchat_desc: Settings for the custom chat box
customHUD_menu_teammatepanels_desc: Settings for the player and teammate panels
customHUD_menu_build_duration_desc: Show build for duration; 0 is permanent
customHUD_menu_callsign_desc: Show the callsign and voice chat icon.
customHUD_menu_equipment_desc: Show throwables, cable ties and deployables.
customHUD_menu_interaction_duration_desc: Minimum interaction timer to show it
customHUD_menu_kill_counter_bots_desc: Show kill counts for team AI
customHUD_menu_kill_counter_specials_des: Separate special kills from other units
customHUD_menu_opacity_desc: Transparency/alpha of panel (1 is solid, 0 is invisible)
customHUD_menu_scale_desc: Scale of all elements of the panel.
customHUD_menu_special_equipment_rows_de: Number of special equipment items in each column
customHUD_menu_weapon_ammo_aggregate_des: Aggregate weapon ammo or show magazine/total separately
customHUD_menu_weapon_ammo_desc: Show/hide weapon ammo. 0: off, 1: on, 2: selected only, 3: unselected only
customHUD_menu_weapon_fire_mode_desc: Show/hide weapon fire mode. 0: off, 1: on, 2: selected only, 3: unselected only
customHUD_menu_weapon_icon_desc: Show/hide weapon icon. 0: off, 1: on, 2: selected only, 3: unselected only
customHUD_menu_enable_interaction_desc: Enables the Interaction timer, circle and text scale.
customHUD_menu_circle_scale_desc: Scale of the interaction circle (requires interaction tweaks enabled)
customHUD_menu_text_scale_desc: Scale of the interaction text (requires interaction tweaks enabled)
customHUD_menu_joinsound_desc: Join sound (uses infamy sound). 0: off, 1: only players with infamy, 2: all players (requires Joininfo enabled)
customHUD_menu_line_height_desc: Size of each line in chat (and hence the text size)
customHUD_menu_x_offset_desc: % offset from left of HUD panel
customHUD_menu_y_offset_desc: % offset from top of HUD panel
customHUD_menu_fade_delay_desc: Fade delay for chat window after inactivity.
